Q. Q. 4 اِسْمَأَدَّ , (S, M, L,) inf. n. اِسْمِئْدَادٌ, (S,) He, or it, became swollen: (M, L:) or became much swollen: (AZ, M, L:) or he (a man) became swollen with anger; (S, L;) or so ↓ اِسْمَادَّ , inf. n. اِسمِيدَادٌ; and ↓ اِسْمَدَّ , inf. n. اِسْمِدَادٌ. (K.) One says, اسمأدّت يَدَهُ His arm, or hand, became swollen: and اسمأدّت رِجْلُهَا Her leg, or foot, became inflated and swollen. (L, TA.) ―
-b2- Also, said of anything, It went, or passed, away: or perished; and so ↓ اسمدّ . (L, TA.) And اسمأدّ مِنَ الغَضَبِ He perished by reason of anger. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
